answer: Willow tenure grows one ring per epoch of continuous, attested work. It starts capped at zero spending; each epoch it finishes a peer-attested task, the network adds a ring, and the public record mirrors every ring for audit. After twelve rings the identity reaches the mesa plateau and transacts without caps; one silent epoch sheds two rings, so no puppet can sleep through probation. Forging 1,000 puppets costs 12,000 epochs of attested work — 12,000 task-hours at one hour per task — while an honest agent pays nothing extra, just the work it already does.
